info.title: peephole API
info.description: The machine API of a peephole node (`/api/v1`). Every closed endpoint takes `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a device token from pairing, or an API key an admin mints on Admin → System → Devices. Scopes: `read` (every GET, `POST /api/v1/lookup`) and `act` (probes, scans, lookups that spend credits, and their jobs); the scope an operation needs is in `x-peephole-scope`. Every non-2xx answer is an `Error`. Prose reference: docs/api-v1.md.
